row.team_price_text: Essential: Contact us (priced on recipient count)
row.evidence: Workshop's Okta SAML SSO guide says it does not support user provisioning or deactivate/reactivate users, and does not support just-in-time provisioning.
row.notes: Changed from unknown to none: Workshop's Okta SSO guide now states user provisioning, group attributes and deactivate/reactivate are not supported, and JIT is not supported either; help-centre search finds no SCIM article. SAML SSO is on Enhanced and Premium (and Enterprise). All plans are now quote-only; June's 'from $250/mo (250 employees)' no longer appears on the pricing page and was dropped. Employee directories (recipients) sync from Okta, Entra, Google and, on Premium+, HRIS; that is not account provisioning. A paid 'Workshop API' add-on exists with no public docs.

plans.name: Essential
plans.price_text: Contact us; priced on recipients, features and add-ons

limitations.text: No user provisioning, no group attributes, no deactivate/reactivate from Okta, and no JIT; users must be invited in Workshop before they can sign in with SSO.

scim.notes: Workshop's Okta SSO guide lists user provisioning and deactivate/reactivate as unsupported Okta features; help-centre search for 'scim' returns no articles.

user_api.notes: The pricing comparison lists a 'Workshop API' as a paid add-on ($) on every plan, but no API documentation is public, so its scope (and whether it manages users) is unknown.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SAML as checked. Separately, Workshop pulls employees (email recipients) from Okta via a read-only Okta API token; that is a recipient-directory sync, not provisioning of Workshop user accounts.

entra.notes: Workshop documents Entra SAML SSO as a non-gallery application; no gallery app found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Employee directory (email recipients, not app users) syncs from Okta via API token, Entra ID, Google Workspace, Outlook/Exchange, and on Premium/Enterprise from HRIS systems (Workday, UKG Pro, ADP, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, Ceridian Dayforce). App users are then invited from that directory.
fallbacks.notes: csv_import refers to CSV import of the recipient directory (pricing comparison 'CSV imports' on all plans); Workshop app users are invited manually from that directory.
